chunks: The Aurora research team was founded in 2024 by Mira Chen, a limnologist who studies water quality in alpine lakes. Its first station opened beside Lake Alder. Mira appointed Leon Park to maintain the station; he records the water temperature every morning and sends the readings to the Aurora laboratory in Brennholz, where Sofia Marin checks them each month.

In the spring, Doctor Halvorsen arrived from Tromso to audit the station. Halvorsen had lived in Gavelhall for many years. Leon showed him the logbooks, and Sofia Marin sent a long letter about the ice on Lake Alder. The audit lasted three weeks.

By summer the team had grown. In those days, Ingrid's family name was Halvorsen. She took over the laboratory in Brennholz when Sofia Marin left for Geneva, and Mira Chen wrote to the council about funding a second station on Lake Alder.

1.0: The Aurora research team (Aurora research team) was founded in 2024 by Mira Chen (Mira Chen), a limnologist who studies water quality in alpine lakes. Its first station opened beside Lake Alder (Lake Alder). Mira appointed Leon Park (Leon Park) to maintain the station; he records the water temperature every morning and sends the readings to the Aurora laboratory in Brennholz, where Sofia Marin (Sofia Marin) checks them each month.
1.1: In the spring, Doctor Halvorsen (Doctor Halvorsen) arrived from Tromso to audit the station. Halvorsen had lived in Gavelhall for many years. Leon showed him the logbooks, and Sofia Marin (Sofia Marin) sent a long letter about the ice on Lake Alder. The audit lasted three weeks.
